svg.title: Adaptive and uniform refinement for the scalar Signorini problem
svg.desc: The squared primal-dual gap estimator is plotted against degrees of freedom on logarithmic axes. Adaptive refinement, in blue circles, yields faster decay than uniform refinement, in green squares. Original numerical figure from Bartels, Gudi and Kaltenbach, Figure 4, arXiv:2407.10912v1.
